findings.claim: Intel Q3 2026 10-Q：2026 年前九個月資產減損為 39 億美元非現金商譽減損（Q1 認列，與 Mobileye 相關）
findings.excerpt: Asset impairment charges incurred in the first nine months of 2026 were related to non-cash goodwill impairment charges of $ 3.9billion.

findings.claim: FY2025 年報資產負債表：總資產 2,114 億美元（含商譽 239 億美元），長期債約 441 億美元；商譽仍佔帳面資產一定比重
findings.source: Intel Form ARS FY2025 balance sheet (Dec 27, 2025)

findings.claim: Q3 2026 10-Q：稅務應收款 74 億美元（2025 年底 76 億）；Q2 10-Q 指因美國境內估值備抵，2026 上半年虧損無法取得稅務利益
findings.excerpt: Additionally, our Consolidated Condensed Balance Sheets as of September 26, 2026 and December 27, 2025 contain certain tax receivables of $ 7.4billion and $ 7.6billion.
